claims.summary: A single eastward event injection at node_10 that fans out through a 2x2 mesh to all twelve output drives via internal node-to-node routing.
claims.subject: flow_000_IONetwork_i_driveEast_10
claims.explanation: The flow starts at i_driveEast_10 into node_10, which can route the event to its own outputs (o_driveEast_10, o_driveLocal_10, o_driveSouth_10) and to internal wires w_drive10200 and w_drive10211. These wires connect to node_00 and node_11 respectively, which then propagate to node_01, ultimately reaching all twelve output endpoints. The mesh topology allows the single input to reach every output through multiple paths.

claims.subject: node_00, node_11, node_01
claims.summary: Intermediate mesh nodes that propagate the event from node_10 to remaining outputs.
claims.explanation: node_00 receives the event via w_drive10200 from node_10 and can route to its own outputs (local, south, west) and to node_01 via w_drive00201. node_11 receives via w_drive10211 and routes to its outputs (east, local, north) and to node_01 via w_drive11201. node_01 receives from both node_00 and node_11 and routes to its outputs (local, north, west). Together they complete the fan-out to all twelve endpoints.
